analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($292.36) vs SMA5/20/50 ($277.32/$269.81/$244.97) — above short-term and mid-term trends.
· High position relative to SMA100/200 ($199.41/$210.26) — maintaining long-term trend strength.
· 52-week position (99.3%) + approaching historical highs.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (58.6 → 72.1) — entering overbought territory, indicating overheated momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-1.9341 → -0.0930) — improving from weakness, but still below zero.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Upper $284.89) — breaking above the upper band, with band width at 11.18% expansion.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($253.00) — based on 20-day low.
· Swing resistance ($293.56) — 52-week high, potential for further upside on breakout.
· 5-day/20-day price pattern (range-bound) — trend reversal requires confirmation.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.35x) — low confidence in current price movement.
· Current stage diagnosis (uptrend) — maintaining a wait-and-see approach due to proximity to 52-week high and low volume.
